scenes.title: The paper stays the same
scenes.viewerPurpose: The paper stays the same, but a famous name changes how people read it.
scenes.composition: One unchanged manuscript lies under a detachable affiliation slip.
addOrChange: Keep the opening manipulation modest; remove the inspection lens until evidence is discussed.

cues.visualAction: Move only the familiar affiliation slip into view; keep every manuscript mark fixed.
Show the book title beside the unchanged paper, with the name remaining separate from its evidence.

scenes.title: A busy editor’s shortcut
scenes.viewerPurpose: A manuscript reaches busy editors who cannot check everything in equal depth.
scenes.composition: A busy reviewer has several papers but limited time for checking.
addOrChange: Remove unsupported observation records and extra pointing arms from this short scene; add a modest clock.

cues.visualAction: The reviewer looks between several papers and the clock, without a rejection stamp.
Shift attention briefly toward the familiar name and then back to the manuscript.

scenes.title: When reputation travels
scenes.viewerPurpose: Those shortcuts can be useful, yet they do not change the experiment behind the paper.
scenes.composition: The same manuscript receives attention while its underlying record stays unchanged.
addOrChange: Replace the dense labor accounting scene with three distinct attention records; label them clearly.

cues.visualAction: Keep the experiment marks fixed as a citation note appears beside the paper.
Add a funding inquiry and a second citation note around the same paper, without numerical claims.

scenes.title: Look at the evidence
scenes.viewerPurpose: It asks how research can earn trust without making every reader start from zero.
scenes.composition: A reader compares a claim in the book with its supporting record.
addOrChange: Remove the long chapter-hand animation and peripheral screen; keep the reading invitation on the actual evidence.

cues.visualAction: Let the reader bring the underlying record beside the book.
Rest the reader’s hand near the evidence while the affiliation slip moves out of focus.

checks: Do not generate voice until all122 script and visual plans pass review.
Use only source-grounded diagrams and neutral illustrative examples; preserve uncertainty and proposal labels.
Measure audio and keep the complete film at or below120 seconds without accelerating narration.
Inspect Color, Light and Dark at desktop and phone sizes; verify captions, labels and cue timing.
Listening review and visual QA are separate from having a compiled film.
